Our first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/dmmgames/sale/shiravune-publisher-sale]Shiravune Publisher Sale[/url] is live now on Steam! Shiravune's entire lineup of Japanese visual novels is on sale, with featured discounts on the legendary [i]Utawarerumono[/i] series of epic fantasy tactics RPGs!

[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151450/Utawarerumono_Prelude_to_the_Fallen/
Unravel the secrets of the world—and your past—in this remake of the first [i]Utawarerumono[/i] game! Why do all the people have such fluffy tails...?!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149550/Utawarerumono_Mask_of_Deception/
Adventure across the enigmatic land of Yamato with a new cast! Get to know fan-favorite characters like the lazy layabout Haku and kindly apothecary Kuon as new mysteries come into view!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151440/Utawarerumono_Mask_of_Truth/
Learn new secrets and old, redeem ancient sins, and save the land of Yamato from unprecedented peril!
